# K Gopal Krishna's Public Repertoire

> The personal website of K Gopal Krishna, also known as kayg or kaygdotorg. Infrastructure engineering, Linux, storage, self-hosting, software, cinema, and photography.

This is a personal website. Writing expresses the author's views and may describe tools or configurations as they existed at publication time. Check article dates when using technical instructions.

The links below point to public HTML pages. Photography currently includes clearly labelled sample images for a layout preview; those images are not the author's original photographs. The Apps page is currently a placeholder.

## About and contact

- [Home](https://kayg.org/): Profile, section overview, and work experience.
- [About](https://kayg.org/about): Background, interests, resume link, and contact information.
- [Contact](https://kayg.org/about#contact): Email and public social profiles.

## Writing and projects

- [Writing](https://kayg.org/blog): Articles about infrastructure, Linux, storage, software, and cinema.
- [Talks](https://kayg.org/talks): Presentations and technical talks.
- [Homelab](https://kayg.org/homelab): Self-hosting and infrastructure notes.
- [Apps](https://kayg.org/apps): Apps and small software projects; currently a placeholder.

## Personal updates

- [Now](https://kayg.org/now): Dated updates about current interests and activities.
- [Uses](https://kayg.org/uses): Hardware, software, and setup notes.
- [Photography](https://kayg.org/photography): Photography gallery; current sample cards preview the layout.

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://kayg.org/changelog): Website changes.
- [Sitemap](https://kayg.org/sitemap-index.xml): Index of generated sitemaps for discovering published pages.
